objective_convention: Q in EUR of total discounted cost. Coupled arms: primary gross_operational_cost = settlement excluded in full (pin excluded, salvage separate), contracted-excluded beside it. Pinned arms: gross_operational_cost = contracted settlement and pin excluded. C_central: step 3 gross EUR/day (settlement weight 0, no row 18, no pin, no salvage). e_b(k) = Q_b(k) - w_b C_central and D_b = w_b C_central - Q_pin,b in EUR of total discounted cost

interpretations.tail_depth_cycle: spec iii: round k of network_ipopt_solve_records.jsonl (final file; the append file when the final one is absent) has >= 1 record and every record compl_inf_tol_in_force == 1e-6
interpretations.S_b_one_sign: "valid only with >= 6 steps of one sign": every step of the window (excluding none) has the same sign and there are >= 6 steps; steps are taken only between consecutive cycle numbers both in the window set
interpretations.S_b_heldout_prediction: Q_hat(k0 + m) = Q(k0) + delta_k0 x sum_{j=1..m} r^j, k0 the last fitted cycle, delta_k0 its observed step, r from the fit on the window minus its last h = 3 cycles (the same form as Q_hat_inf = Q(K) + delta_K r / (1 - r))
interpretations.omega_rms: omega-RMS of dX_s over a block (year, day): sqrt(sum_s omega_s x mean over the block's nodes and periods of dX_s^2); max = max over nodes, scenarios and periods of |dX_s|
interpretations.v_base_kv: v_b per node = capture expectation TSO v (terminal line) / interface_voltage_terminal tso_pu, per period; checked constant to rel 1e-9 over periods; if the ratio is ~1 the capture v is in pu and v_b = 1 is used (recorded)
interpretations.P6_wall: mean of per_cycle_record cycle_wall_s over cycles 1..cycles(arm)
interpretations.M3_float_repr: json.dumps(sort_keys=True) after removing the excluded keys recursively; exact string equality
